account_id.description: The owning account ID (a biz_ identifier). Provide this or user_id.

user_id.description: The owning user ID (a user_ identifier). Provide this or account_id.

status.description: Optional status filter. `created` means saved but unused, `active` means a payout through it succeeded, `broken` means the last payout failed and the method needs fixing.

amount.description: Optional payout amount in whole currency units, for example `250.00`. When provided, each method includes a quote with the estimated fee, amount received, and delivery date for that amount.

currency.description: Currency code of the amount, for example `usd`. Only meaningful with amount or include_limits.

include_limits.description: When true, the response also carries limits — the live per-speed payout caps the account's payout requests are validated against, in the requested currency. Requires the payout:withdrawal:read scope.

first.description: Number of results to return from the start of the range.

after.description: Return results after this cursor. Use `page_info.end_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page.

last.description: Number of results to return from the end of the range.

before.description: Return results before this cursor. Use `page_info.start_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the previous page.
